subject: Transportation Systems
title: Returns and Reverse Logistics
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Returns and Reverse Logistics.

hook.text: Online retailers see 20 to 30 percent of purchases returned. Moving goods backward is a nightmare.

buildup.text: Reverse logistics covers returns, recycling, and disposal. It's messy, expensive, and often ignored.

discovery.text: Returned items rarely go back on the shelf. Many are liquidated, donated, or sent to landfill.

twist.text: Free returns encourage over-ordering. Shoppers buy three sizes and send two back. Costs are staggering.

climax.text: Some retailers now charge for returns. Others use AI sizing tools to prevent the return before it happens.

punchline.text: Shipping it there is hard. Shipping it back is harder.

quiz.question: What is reverse logistics?
options: Managing the flow of returned, recycled, or disposed goods
